topics.topic: Boundary between M10, bindings, and service_invoker for instance-related fields and validation
questions: Are `required_headers` and instance `class` part of M10, or separate data that bindings/service_invoker pass outside M10?
Which module is responsible for detecting and reporting a missing selected instance (or missing instance fields): `bindings` during current-check, or `service_invoker` during request preparation?

topics.topic: Approve/refuse/resolve contract: required identifiers and check ordering across `runs` and `effects`
questions: What identifiers must the approve/refuse/resolve operations carry so `runs` can check run-ended first without owning approval/attempt lookup?

topics.topic: Crash-consistency and startup recovery guarantees when owner refusal is partially persisted
questions: If the process crashes after `effects` writes `refused_by_owner` but before `runs` writes run status, what persisted run status is guaranteed, and will start-up recovery process it?

topics.topic: Ownership and timing for enforcing unique `agent_name` values
questions: Which module must enforce unique `agent_name` values, and at which moments (start only, or also token-list re-read)?

topics.topic: Startup sequencing decision: when to acquire the exclusive data-directory lock
questions: Must the exclusive data-directory lock be acquired before any other start checks, or only when store.open_store runs after installation/manifest checks?
